jobs.title: PMO AI Leader - Client Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology company that leads with outcomes and teams with leaders, bringing more together. Our purpose is to help people and organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Every day we bring our heads and our hearts to being a trusted copilot, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion for each of our customers.
Our strategic vision is to be the first in our industry to lead with bringing more and delivering outcomes as we work to become the world’s most customer-obsessed and employee-empowered services company. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Who You'll Work With

Our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We connect across all technical and advisory capabilities, bringing strategy to life through delivery execution that is rigorous, adaptive and outcome driven. 
You'll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about helping clients solve their toughest business and technology challenges. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it is a multi-workstream delivery or PMO transformation, we bring clarity, structure and momentum to every engagement. 
We work in-person with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are, whether Agile, Waterfall, hybrid or product-based. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows.
As a Delivery Leader focused on AI-enabled client delivery, you will be a consulting leader who assesses how clients deliver projects and products, designs fit-for-purpose PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, and leads the creation and adoption of practical AI agents and accelerators. You will combine program leadership, product delivery, governance, change enablement, and hands-on solution shaping to move clients from current-state assessment through pilot execution, measurable value realization, and responsilbe scale. 

Job Title:

PMO AI Leader - Client Delivery

What You’ll Do

L ead the successful delivery of projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, change control, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.

I ndependently establish program governance, executive reporting, integrated plans, decision frameworks, delivery health reviews, quality gates, and escalation practices that enable timely decisions and predictable execution.

O wn engagement and account financials, including margin, staffing, forecasting, managed revenue, utilization, and profitability.

B uild strategic client relationships, strengthen Slalom's trusted advisor position, and identify opportunities to expand AI-enabled Delivery, Product, Data, Change, and Technology capabilities.

L ead AI-enabled PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, and product delivery maturity assessments across strategy, governance, processes, tools, team structure, skills, data readiness, automation, adoption, and value measurement.

C onduct stakeholder interviews, working sessions, artifact reviews, workflow analysis, and capability assessments to identify delivery gaps, bottlenecks, compliance considerations, and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

Translate assessment findings into prioritized opportunity heatmaps, baseline metrics, business cases, target operating models, implementation roadmaps, and recommendations for pilot and enterprise-scale adoption.
Define fit-for-purpose delivery frameworks that combine Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, product-based, and AI-enabled practices while meeting client governance, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements.
Design PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, including governance forums, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, delivery standards, stage gates, escalation paths, metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Design, configure, and help build AI agents and agentic workflows by defining business outcomes, context, instructions, tools, data sources, rules, thresholds, human approval points, exception handling, and evaluation criteria.
Provide hands-on coaching to Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams as they adopt new delivery practices, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving human-and-agent responsibilities.
Champion Delivery Excellence by creating repeatable frameworks, governance standards, quality practices, metrics, accelerators, and reusable assets across engagements.
Coach consultants providing feedback while contributing to capability development, and knowledge sharing.
Maintain 85%+ personal utilization while supporting team utilization, capability health, and broader market priorities.

What You’ll Bring

8 + years of consulting experience leading business and technology transformation initiatives within a client-facing professional services or consulting environment.

P roven experience leading PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, product delivery, SDLC, or AI-PDLC maturity and readiness assessments and translating findings into operating models, roadmaps, pilots, and measurable improvement plans.

D emonstrated ability to assess end-to-end delivery processes, team capabilities, governance, tooling, data readiness, automation, change impacts, and organizational readiness through interviews, workshops, artifact reviews, and workflow analysis.

H ands-on experience identifying, designing, configuring, prototyping, or delivering enterprise AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, or AI-enabled delivery accelerators.

W orking knowledge of large language models, context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, APIs and integrations, knowledge repositories, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Experience moving AI solutions from use-case discovery and prioritization through prototype, pilot, validation, deployment readiness, adoption, value measurement, and responsible scale.
Strong understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, model and agent risk, data governance, access controls, auditability, compliance, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Ability to define practical success measures and business cases for AI-enabled delivery, including improvements to cycle time, quality, forecasting, risk identification, administrative effort, adoption, and value realization.
Expertise in Agile, Waterfall, SAFe, hybrid, and product-based delivery models, with the judgment to tailor methods to client needs, maturity, risk, and regulatory context.
Demonstrated success managing engagement budgets, staffing, contractual commitments, forecasting, margin, utilization, profitability, and delivery quality.
Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, consulting, and leadership skills, with the ability to connect business, product, delivery, data, change, and technology stakeholders through complexity and ambiguity.
A growth mindset, and commitment to continuous learning, responsible innovation, delivery excellence, and Slalom's values.

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Hybrid/In office:
We are hybrid but there are expectations that if your team leader or client requires you onsite that you are able to meet those expectations/requirements

Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this position, the expected base salary pay range is $135,000 to $160,000. In addition, there is potential for a 15% discretionary bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation will depend upon individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

Slalom Employee Perks:

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform Governance
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

You will be joining CIBC’s Chief Data and AI Office team. As the Director, Data Platform Governance, you are expected to be a seasoned professional in leadership and coaching responsible for providing direct application delivery services and production support, undertaking new initiatives and base essential support applications. The role applies leadership skills and technical expertise to direct, manage and support large and critical applications on a day to day basis, leading internal change initiatives in alignment with ongoing technological changes. The Director, Data Platform Governance manages relationships with internal partners, maintaining continuous business communications with them to proactively assess any disruption in application functioning. In addition, the role leads the ongoing operations of applications and infrastructure in production, adhering to operational standards, vendor governance and business requirements. The role drives innovation across areas of responsibility, applying expert interpersonal, communications, and problem-solving skills.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How You'll Succeed

Delivery Focused – Work closely with internal partners to determine, negotiate and manage projects to the agreed upon timeline. Monitor finances identify opportunities for improvement and recommend appropriate solutions. Under your leadership implement projects in a timely fashion that are of high quality, low cost and on budget.
People Leadership – Lead and coach a high performing group team of individuals. Direct, motivate, and develop your team, maximizing their contributions and professional growth. Share knowledge and collaborate to come up with effective solutions to problems.
Relationship Management – Work closely with project teams, executives, stakeholders and business partners to develop, and implement application programs. Impact and improve the business by advising application owners on the technology implementation possibilities and requirements.
Moderate the Solution Creation Process: Lead, facilitate and coordinate the solution design, including ensuring alignment across multiple workstreams.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned technical delivery leader. You have 7+ years of demonstrated experience in: technical architecture, solutions design, project management, and senior executive stakeholder management. It's an asset if you have fulfilled leadership and advisory roles for major functions and/or initiatives with the responsibility, authority and discretion for decision-making. You also have a technical background, sufficient depth and breadth to be able to recognize and successfully exploit opportunities for effective development or usage of IT, and lead/guide fully experienced technical specialists.
You have highly developed analytical and conceptual skills. You are adept at developing efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex problems.
You are a bold and authentic leader. You're passionate about developing and coaching to bring out the best in people. You have led diverse, high performing teams.
You embrace and champion change. You'll continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.
You're driven by collective success. You know that collaboration can transform a good idea into a great one. You understand the power of an inclusive team that enjoys working together to create a shared vision
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com

We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

jobs.title: Lead AI Security Automation Engineer, VP
Responsable de l’expérience numérique / Digital Experience Leader, Customer Support
jobs.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

Le ou la Responsable de l’expérience numérique
est chargé(e) de transformer le service de soutien à la clientèle de OneSpan en une expérience de soutien axée d’abord sur le numérique et propulsée par l’intelligence artificielle
. Ce rôle consiste à identifier et à mettre en œuvre des cas d’usage où les clients peuvent demander et obtenir de l’aide par l’intermédiaire de canaux numériques, notamment le portail de soutien client, les agents conversationnels (chatbots) et assistants virtuels, l’IA agentique, la recherche alimentée par l’IA, les formulaires structurés, l’automatisation des flux de travail, les capacités de libre-service ainsi que les améliorations apportées aux produits, avec peu ou pas d’intervention d’un agent du soutien à la clientèle de OneSpan.

La principale mesure de réussite consiste à atteindre un taux de résolution numérique de 60 % pour les demandes admissibles des clients non premium
, permettant ainsi à l’organisation du soutien à la clientèle de consacrer davantage de capacité aux interventions premium, complexes et à forte valeur ajoutée.

Un soutien à la clientèle de calibre mondial

Le soutien à la clientèle de OneSpan s’engage à contribuer au succès de ses clients grâce à un service rapide, compétent, courtois et réactif. Ce poste prolonge cette mission en modernisant la manière dont les clients reçoivent de l’assistance : en améliorant le libre-service, en réduisant les frictions, en accélérant la résolution des demandes et en assurant un transfert fluide vers un agent humain lorsque la résolution numérique n’est pas appropriée.

Principales responsabilités

Définir et piloter la feuille de route de la transformation numérique du soutien, couvrant le portail client, la recherche IA, les agents conversationnels et assistants virtuels, les formulaires structurés, l’automatisation des flux de travail, l’IA agentique, la gestion des connaissances, la documentation et les fonctionnalités de libre-service intégrées aux produits.
Identifier les types de demandes récurrentes et à fort volume pouvant être prévenus, automatisés, résolus en libre-service, améliorés grâce à la documentation ou éliminés par des améliorations produit.
Diriger la feuille de route nécessaire pour atteindre un taux de résolution numérique de 60 % des demandes admissibles non premium, tout en maintenant une expérience de soutien premium de grande qualité.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de gestion de produit, d’ingénierie, des TI, les responsables de plateformes comme ServiceNow, les équipes de gestion des connaissances et de la documentation, les opérations de soutien, le succès client et les équipes de soutien de première ligne.
Assurer la coordination des initiatives selon les pratiques BPM et PMO, notamment la cartographie des processus, la planification des initiatives, l’élaboration de dossiers d’affaires, le suivi des dépendances, l’alignement des parties prenantes, la planification de l’adoption et la production de rapports destinés à la direction.
Améliorer les processus de collecte structurée des demandes, de triage, de classification, d’acheminement, de recommandations de résolution, de gestion des SLA et des escalades, ainsi que l’expérience des agents.
Mettre en place des tableaux de bord de performance pour suivre la résolution numérique, le taux de confinement, l’adoption du libre-service, la qualité de l’IA et de l’automatisation, la déviation des cas, l’expérience client et l’efficacité du soutien.
Veiller à ce que les solutions d’IA et d’automatisation soient déployées avec une gouvernance appropriée, des mécanismes de transfert vers l’humain, la protection des données clients, la transparence et une surveillance continue.
Transformer les apprentissages tirés du soutien à la clientèle en améliorations des produits, des processus, du portail, de la documentation et de la base de connaissances.

Objectifs et indicateurs de performance (KPI)

Atteindre un taux de résolution numérique de 60 % pour les demandes de soutien admissibles des clients non premium.
Accroître l’utilisation des canaux de soutien numériques, de la recherche alimentée par l’IA, du libre-service, des formulaires structurés et des flux de travail automatisés.
Réduire le volume de demandes répétitives non premium devant être traitées par les agents.
Améliorer l’effort client, la rapidité de résolution, l’efficacité opérationnelle et la cohérence du parcours de soutien.
Augmenter la capacité du soutien à la clientèle pour les interactions premium et les dossiers complexes.
Améliorer la qualité et l’actualité des connaissances, de la documentation et du contenu prêt pour l’IA.
Réaliser des améliorations mesurables aux processus, aux outils, aux produits et au portail client.

Exigences

Transformation numérique du soutien à la clientèle

Expérience démontrée dans la transformation des organisations de soutien à la clientèle grâce au libre-service, à l’automatisation, à l’intelligence artificielle et aux canaux numériques, avec des résultats mesurables en matière d’expérience client, d’efficacité opérationnelle et de capacité d’expansion du soutien.

Stratégie d’IA, d’automatisation et de libre-service

Expérience dans l’identification, la priorisation et la mise en œuvre de capacités de soutien alimentées par l’IA, de solutions d’automatisation des flux de travail, d’agents conversationnels et d’assistants virtuels, de libre-service fondé sur les connaissances et de parcours clients numériques.

Gestion des processus d’affaires (BPM) et livraison de programmes

Solides compétences en amélioration de processus et en gestion de programme (PMO), incluant la cartographie des processus, l’élaboration de dossiers d’affaires, la gestion de feuilles de route, l’alignement des parties prenantes, la gestion des dépendances et l’exécution d’initiatives de transformation interfonctionnelles.

Leadership transversal et influence

Capacité éprouvée à diriger des initiatives touchant le soutien à la clientèle, la gestion de produit, l’ingénierie, les TI, le succès client et les opérations, sans autorité hiérarchique directe, en favorisant l’alignement et l’atteinte des résultats d’affaires.

Prise de décision fondée sur les données

Excellentes compétences analytiques et expérience dans la définition et la gestion d’indicateurs de performance, ainsi que dans l’utilisation des données clients et opérationnelles pour identifier des occasions d’amélioration, mesurer l’adoption et favoriser l’optimisation continue.

Qualifications Souhaitées (atouts)

Expertise des plateformes de gestion des services

Expérience pratique avec ServiceNow, Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, Gainsight ou des plateformes comparables de soutien à la clientèle et d’automatisation des flux de travail.

Expérience dans les secteurs SaaS, cybersécurité ou fintech

Expérience dans des environnements technologiques réglementés tels que les logiciels SaaS B2B, la cybersécurité, l’identité numérique, l’authentification, les technologies financières (fintech) ou des domaines connexes.

Gestion des connaissances et recherche alimentée par l’IA

Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de programmes de gestion des connaissances, de solutions de recherche alimentées par l’IA, d’architectures basées sur la génération augmentée par récupération (RAG), de stratégies de documentation ou de méthodologies Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS).

Gouvernance de l’IA et IA responsable

Expérience dans l’établissement de cadres de gouvernance pour le soutien client assisté par l’IA, incluant le suivi de la qualité, les processus avec intervention humaine, la gestion des risques, la protection de la vie privée et la conformité.

Expérience en leadership

Expérience préalable dans la création, la direction ou le développement d’équipes hautement performantes au sein du soutien à la clientèle, de l’expérience client, de la transformation numérique, des opérations de soutien ou des opérations produit.

Certifications professionnelles

Certifications pertinentes telles que PMP, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, KCS, COPC, CCXP ou certifications liées à la gestion des processus d’affaires (BPM).

The Digital Experience Leader
is responsible for transforming OneSpan Customer Support into a digital-first, AI-enabled support experience
. The role will identify and deliver support use cases where customers can request and receive help through digital channels — including the customer support portal, chatbot/virtual agent, Agentic AI, AI search, structured intake, workflow automation, self-service capabilities, and product enhancements — with no or minimal interaction from a OneSpan Customer Support agent.

The primary success measure is to enable 60% digital resolution for eligible non-premium customer requests
, allowing the Customer Support organization to focus more capacity on premium, complex, and high-value customer engagements.

World class customer support

OneSpan Customer Support is committed to helping customers succeed through timely, knowledgeable, courteous, and responsive service. This role extends that mission by modernizing how customers receive support: improving self-service, reducing friction, accelerating resolution, and ensuring smooth human handoff when digital resolution is not appropriate.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Own the digital support transformation roadmap across portal, AI search, chatbot/virtual agent, structured forms, workflow automation, Agentic AI, knowledge, documentation, and product self-service.
Identify high-volume and recurring request types that can be prevented, automated, resolved through self-service, improved through documentation, or eliminated through product enhancements.
Drive the roadmap required to achieve 60% digital resolution for eligible non-premium requests while preserving a high-quality premium support experience.
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, IT, ServiceNow/platform owners, Knowledge/Documentation, Support Operations, Customer Success, and frontline Support teams.
Lead BPM and PMO-style coordination, including process mapping, initiative planning, business case definition, dependency tracking, stakeholder alignment, adoption planning, and executive reporting.
Improve structured intake, triage, classification, routing, resolution guidance, SLA/escalation workflows, and agent experience.
Establish KPI dashboards for digital resolution, containment, self-service adoption, AI/automation quality, case deflection, customer experience, and support efficiency.
Ensure AI and automation are implemented with appropriate governance, human handoff, customer data protection, transparency, and continuous monitoring.
Convert support insights into product, process, portal, documentation, and knowledgebase improvements.

Objectives / KPI’s

Achieve 60% digital resolution for eligible non-premium customer support requests.
Increase use of digital support channels, AI search, self-service, structured intake, and automated workflows.
Reduce avoidable agent-handled volume for repeatable non-premium requests.
Improve customer effort, resolution speed, efficiency, and support journey consistency.
Increase Customer Support capacity for premium and complex customer engagements.
Improve quality and freshness of knowledge, documentation, and AI-ready content.
Deliver measurable process, tooling, product, and portal improvements.

Requirements

Customer Support Digital Transformation - Demonstrated experience transforming customer support organizations through self-service, automation, AI, and digital channels, with measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and support scalability.

The Manitoba government recognizes the importance of building an exemplary public service reflective of the citizens it serves, where diverse abilities, backgrounds, cultures, identities, languages and perspectives drives a high standard of service and innovation. The Manitoba government supports equitable employment practices and promotes representation of designated groups (women, Indigenous people, persons with disabilities, visible minorities).

Employment Equity is a factor in selection for this competition. Consideration will be given to Indigenous people, visible minorities and persons with disabilities.

Elections Manitoba (EM) is an integrity-driven organization dedicated to ensuring free, fair, and accessible elections for the people of Manitoba. As an independent office of the Manitoba Legislative Assembly, EM is steadfast in upholding the core values of democracy. The team at EM is committed to fairness, integrity, respect, excellence, participation, innovation, and accountability, striving to create an environment where every voice is heard and every vote counts.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented and hands-on leader to join our Senior Leadership Team as the Director of Corporate Services and Finance. This is a unique and meaningful role for someone who thrives on purpose-driven work, is committed to public service, and excels in a fast-paced environment where adaptability and sound judgment are essential.

As Director, you will balance day-to-day operations with strategic oversight across the various administrative and corporate functions for Elections Manitoba as well as ensuring campaign finance is conducted as mandated in The Election Financing Act (EFA) . The ideal candidate enjoys coaching, implementing, and coordinating corporate administrative services and finance functions.

If you’re driven by results and developing others, we encourage you to apply. This is more than a leadership role — it’s an opportunity to serve the people of Manitoba with integrity and purpose.

Duties:

As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the Director of Corporate Services and Finance is accountable for coaching, performance management and mentoring staff across two portfolios; administrative and corporate functions for EM as well as ensuring campaign finance is conducted as mandated in The Election Financing Act (EFA) . The position provides oversight of innovative and flexible solutions, processes, practices to manage and implement financial and administrative services, campaign review programs, information sharing, approval of and development of legislative requirements for different stakeholders, and internal controls for the cost-effective delivery of corporate and electoral events.

Qualifications:

Essential Skills/expertise

Post secondary education in a related discipline such as Finance or Business Administration. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
Experience translating strategic priorities into clear operational and business plans, and experience with strategic performance management and measurement systems
Extensive experience with administration, financial reporting, budget development, and cash flow management, ensuring compliance in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.
Demonstrated management experience with responsibility for operational, human, and financial resources.
Experience developing, administering, and enforcing legislation, regulations, policies, and guidelines.
Experience supervising and mentoring staff and supporting a collaborative team environment.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement while ensuring operational stability.
Experience in vendor and contract management.
Experience in inventory and asset management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts and develop politically sensitive materials and for diverse audiences.
Strong organizational skills with ability to handle multiple priorities under tight timelines.
Strong political acumen with the ability to manage confidential and politically sensitive material. Demonstrates a high degree of confidentiality, standards of personal conduct, ethical behaviour and common sense.

Desired Skills

Experience working with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, SAP S/4HANA, including financial management, reporting, budgeting, procurement, payroll, and operational processes.
Experience using integrated information systems to support decision-making, reporting, and continuous process improvement.
Election-related experience.
CPA designation (CA, CGA, CMA) in good standing.

Elections Manitoba is seeking candidates who are willing to work on a flexible schedule when operations require; this may include working outside of standard office hours, and willingness to work additional hours, such as during election periods. The incumbent must also be capable of traveling for work-related purposes within Manitoba, and physically capable of lifting, carrying, and transporting equipment.

Conditions of Employment:

Must be legally entitled to work in Canada
The incumbent must be, and remain, politically non-partisan in both perception and fact
Satisfactory criminal records check
Must possess a valid Manitoba Driver’s License with access to a vehicle to use for work-related purposes; use of alternative forms of transportation for persons with accessibility requirements are actively considered.
Ability and willingness to travel throughout Manitoba when operations require
